parameters.name: CategoryId
parameters.description:
The unique ID for a custom figure library. The caller generates this ID and must ensure it is unique. Save this ID to use when you call other APIs.
><notice>This ID cannot be the same as a system figure library ID. If the IDs match, the system figure library is used by default. The ID can be up to 120 characters long, is case-insensitive, and supports characters from any language.></notice>

parameters.name: ImageUrl
parameters.description: The public URL of the image containing the face to register. The image must contain exactly one frontal face.

parameters.name: PersonId
parameters.description:
The ID of the custom person. This ID uniquely identifies a custom person. You generate this ID and ensure its uniqueness. Store it securely for use with other API calls.

> Supports up to 120 characters, supports Chinese and English characters, is case-insensitive, and returns FaceId as a String.
